titulo: First Thing: Details remain unclear after ‘terror attack’ on Dubai-Israel flight
cuerpo: Netanyahu says it is too early to tell who was behind the apparent attempt to crash flight after pilot stabbed Good morning. Benjamin Netanyahu has said it is too early to tell who was ultimately behind the apparent attempt to crash a ⁠Tel Aviv-bound flydubai flight , even as Israel’s ambassador to the UN called the incident a “terror attack”. Flydubai said its flights to and from Israel would be suspended while an investigation takes place. What is believed to have taken place in the cockpit? Pilot Smit Machchhar, an Indian citizen from Mumbai, has been hailed as a hero after releasing the cockpit door to allow passengers in to wrestle back control of the plane, after his co-pilot – reportedly an Omani national – stabbed him and ⁠sent the jet plunging nearly 14,000ft (4,267 metres) in less than 30 seconds. What happened next? One passenger said : “There were two spare pilots who were supposed to operate the next flight. The relief pilots … entered [the cockpit] and pulled the aircraft up, pulled the yoke, stabilised the plane and landed us in Saudi Arabia.” How has Donald Trump responded?
